info.name: Paxos Account Members Deposit Addresses API

params.name: profile_ids
params.description: Optionally filter by the profile IDs associated with the deposit addresses. Limit 100.

params.name: identity_ids
params.description: Optionally filter by the Identities associated with the deposit addresses. Limit 100.

params.name: ids
params.description: Optionally filter by the UUIDs of the deposit addresses. Limit 100.

params.name: ref_ids
params.description: The client-specified IDs provided during transfer creation. Limit 100.

params.name: created_at.lt
params.description: Include timestamps strictly less than lt. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.lte
params.description: Include timestamps less than or equal to lte. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.eq
params.description: Include timestamps exactly equal to eq. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.gte
params.description: Include timestamps greater than or equal to gte. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.gt
params.description: Include timestamps strictly greater than gt. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 100 if no limit is provided. Maximum 1000.

params.name: order
params.description: Return items in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC) order. Defaults to DESC.

params.name: order_by
params.description: The specific method by which the returned results will be ordered.

params.name: page_cursor
params.description: Optional: Cursor for getting the next page of results.

params.name: account_ids
params.description: Optionally filter by the Accounts associated with the deposit address. Limit 100.

params.name: networks
params.description: Optionally filter by the networks of the deposit addresses. Limit 100.

items.docs: List all deposit addresses, optionally filtering and paging the results.

Create a deposit address on a blockchain network for depositing to a profile.

**Important for Stellar Network (PYUSD):**

When creating a deposit address for PYUSD on the Stellar network:

- Paxos automatically handles all necessary setup including trustline establishment
- The deposit address is immediately ready to receive PYUSD tokens
- No additional configuration is required by the user
- The PYUSD issuer address on Stellar mainnet is: `GDQE7IXJ4HUHV6RQHIUPRJSEZE4DRS5WY577O2FY6YQ5LVWZ7JZTU2
